rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for deliberately gathering or accumulating things, including collecting things as a hobby.

example.english: I collect postcards from different places.
example.traditional: 我平時收集唔同地方嘅明信片。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 si4 sau1 zaap6 m4 tung4 dei6 fong1 ge3 ming4 seon3 pin2

rows.note: Use this when picking up or collecting a person, especially from a station, airport, or other place.

example.english: I’ll collect you from the station tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 heoi3 ce1 zaam6 zip3 nei5

rows.note: Use this for picking up or fetching an object rather than a person.

example.english: Can you collect my bag for me?
example.traditional: 你幫我攞返個包得唔得？
example.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 lo2 faan1 go3 baau1 dak1 m4 dak1

rows.note: Use this when taking or collecting money, such as regular payments, fees, or money owed.

example.english: I collect money at the end of every month.
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 go3 jyut6 jyut6 mei5 sau1 cin2
